title: QBE Asia report warns that dependence on external technology suppliers is reshaping cyber risk
date_note: SecurityBrief Asia's article of 27 November reports the QBE Asia report; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: the article names QBE Asia and no city; regional pin, not a stated location
summary: QBE Asia says dependence on external technology suppliers is reshaping cyber risk, so a disruption at one provider can spread across companies and sectors, SecurityBrief Asia reports. Sam Russell-Vick, QBE Asia's Regional Cyber Lead, is quoted saying that often what matters more is what happens next.
plain: An insurer, QBE Asia, says reliance on outside technology suppliers means a problem at one provider can spread to many companies, SecurityBrief Asia reports.
exec: QBE Asia says supplier disruption can spread across companies and sectors, and its Regional Cyber Lead stresses what happens next.

validation.note: One publisher group (SecurityBrief/IT Brief) read; other outlets (insuranceNEWS.com.au, Insurance Edge) and QBE's own report were not read.

review.note: Compared title, summary, Russell-Vick quote, 27 Nov date against SecurityBrief Asia
